metadata.name: Democratic Socialism
metadata.description: The contemporary DSA variant seeking a democratic socialist republic, social ownership, universal provision and expanded workplace democracy.
metadata.period: Contemporary United States; live DSA programme at 4 October 2026
metadata.scope: Democratic socialism articulated by DSA, including its current democratic socialist republic, social-ownership and abolitionist programme. This is a specific organisation’s doctrinal variant, not all democratic socialism, and not a profile of any incumbent national government. This is a sourced interpretation of the specified tradition, not an adherent questionnaire. Unresolved evidence or an unrepresented institutional premise is recorded as unknown, never as numerical neutrality. Historical sources are not treated as answers to modern technologies by analogy. Government acts are contextual evidence only, not a substitute for the scoped doctrine.
metadata.phrase: A society in which people democratically govern political institutions and productive resources to meet shared needs.
